_note: Italian -> English glossary for GisMaster cadastre/planning layers. 'theme' drives map colour and grouping. Meanings marked 'likely' are inferred from Piedmont planning conventions, not stated by the source.

services.Tavola P2: Regional Landscape Plan (PPR) - Table P2: protected landscape assets
services.Tavola P3: Regional Landscape Plan (PPR) - Table P3: landscape areas and units
services.Tavola P4: Regional Landscape Plan (PPR) - Table P4: landscape components

Particelle catastali.description: Land parcels of the cadastral map (Catasto Terreni). Label = parcel number within the sheet (foglio).

Edifici catastali.description: Buildings recorded on the cadastral map. Label = parcel number, with -n suffix for each building on that parcel.

Edifici da concessioni.description: Buildings drawn from municipal building permits (concessioni edilizie), not necessarily registered in the cadastre yet.

ed_prg.description: Buildings from the town plan (PRG) base map.

ed_tm.description: Buildings from the municipal technical map.

Confini catastali.description: Outline of each cadastral map sheet (foglio). Label = sheet code (comune + sheet number + allegato).

Strade.description: Public road areas on the cadastral map (not part of any parcel).

Acque.description: Public water areas on the cadastral map.

Varie.description: Other linework of the cadastral map (e.g. internal divisions, symbols drawn as lines).

Riporti particelle.description: Short lines linking a parcel number to a parcel too small to hold its label.

Frazionamenti non catastali.description: Subdivision lines drawn by the comune that are not (yet) part of the official cadastre.

Linee non catastali.description: Lines drawn by the comune that are not part of the official cadastre.

Simboli catastali.description: Point symbols of the cadastral map (e.g. brackets joining parts of one parcel, boundary marks). Label = the glyph in the cadastral map font.

Testi particelle.description: Text labels with parcel numbers, as placed on the cadastral map.

Testi strade.description: Text labels of roads on the cadastral map.

Testi acque.description: Text labels of watercourses on the cadastral map.

Base PRG.description: Base map linework of the town plan (Piano Regolatore Generale, PRG).

Destinazioni urbanistiche.description: Land-use zones of the town plan (PRG). The zone code determines what may be built.

AreNor.description: Land-use zones of the town plan (PRG) ('aree normative'). The zone code determines what may be built.

Vincolo idrogeologico.description: Area under 'vincolo idrogeologico' (R.D. 3267/1923, L.R. 45/1989): earthworks, tree felling and land-use changes need an authorisation.

Vincolo Idrogeologico.description: Area under 'vincolo idrogeologico' (R.D. 3267/1923, L.R. 45/1989): earthworks, tree felling and land-use changes need an authorisation.

PAI2008.description: Town-plan map of geomorphological hazard and building suitability (PAI adaptation, 2008), following Piedmont Circ. 7/LAP: class I no constraints, class II moderate hazard (building allowed with technical measures), class III high hazard (new building generally not allowed).

zona montana.description: Part of the comune classified as mountain territory.

Fasce di rispetto.description: Setback/buffer zones (roads, watercourses, cemeteries, infrastructure) in which building is restricted.

Vincolo Cimiteriale.description: Cemetery setback zone: new building restricted.

Perimetrazione centro abitato.description: Official boundary of the built-up area (centro abitato).

Salvaguardia ambientale.description: Area under environmental protection in the town plan.

Sorgenti.description: Water springs and their protection zones.

Lettera g) i territori coperti da forest.description: Art. 142(1)(g) D.Lgs. 42/2004: land covered by forest is a protected landscape asset. Works need a landscape authorisation.

Lettera h) Le zone gravate da usi civici.description: Art. 142(1)(h) D.Lgs. 42/2004: land subject to civic (common) use rights.

Lettera c) I fiumi, i torrenti,i corsi d.description: Art. 142(1)(c) D.Lgs. 42/2004: rivers, streams and watercourses.

Lettera c) Fasce di 150m.description: Art. 142(1)(c) D.Lgs. 42/2004: 150 m strip along protected watercourses.

Lettera d) Le montagne per la parte ecce.description: Art. 142(1)(d) D.Lgs. 42/2004: mountain land above 1600 m a.s.l. (Alps).

Ambiti di paesaggio.description: Landscape area ('ambito') of the Piedmont Regional Landscape Plan.

Unità di paesaggio.description: Landscape unit of the Piedmont Regional Landscape Plan, with its character type.

CoperturaBoscata.description: Forest cover mapped by the Regional Landscape Plan (Table P4).

Morfologie insediative.description: Settlement pattern class of the Regional Landscape Plan (Table P4, art. 34-40 NdA); each class has its own building rules.

Aree di elevato interesse agronomico.description: Land of high agricultural value (PPR art. 20).

Praterie - prato - pascoli - cespuglieti.description: Grassland and scrub components of the Regional Landscape Plan.

values.AAM: AAM - agricultural area, mountain (likely 'aree agricole montane')
values.II1: Class II1 - moderate geological hazard; building allowed with technical measures
values.PAICLII1.43: PAI class II1 (area 43) - moderate hazard; building allowed with technical measures
values.PAIClIIIInd.1: PAI class III undifferentiated (area 1) - high hazard; new building generally not allowed
values.m.i. 10: m.i. 10 - rural areas of plain or hill (PPR settlement class 10)
